description: Protect /deploy: user-typed only, this machine only, the project's own procedure first, a backup before replacing, a stop on running or locked targets, no changes to MCP registrations, scheduled tasks, settings or PATH, new icon file names for Explorer's cache, and read-back verification.
must_contain: this machine only: never a server, production, a cloud service or another PC
A project with nothing to install is a valid answer.
Otherwise stop and hand that step to the user

Never edit PATH or
   other environment settings.
Read everything back; a write that returned no error isn't proof.
Change MCP registrations, scheduled tasks or services, harness settings, permission policy or PATH.
Delete a backup or an old install.
